findings.defect: Broad main-bay floor and wall fill weakens distinct inspection-threshold light; header and indicators guide more strongly than light on functional inner faces.
Cargo front, curtain, rollers and lower frame crowd the dark range; blue side receives clearer definition than the cargo-facing work surface.
Gate leaves and supporting posts lack consistent directional separation; overhead structure has stronger accents than functional faces.
Warm wall is more illuminated than the trolley construction; lower rail, shelf and casters merge into near-black masses.
Arrival door leaves, centre joint and frame have weak value separation.

fixes.action: Rebalance and aim existing bay practicals into distinct scanner and cargo pools; reduce spill across approach and interstitial floor without sacrificing route readability.
Redirect restrained practical or bounced light across cargo curtain, crate latches and roller bed; preserve dark tunnel interior while separating curtain edges and lower frame.
Provide low soft indirect fill from support-bay practicals to reveal trolley lower rail, shelf, caster silhouette and floor contact while retaining a dim secondary space.
Use restrained grazing definition from nearby existing sources on arrival and cart gate joints, frames and leaf edges; keep arrival subordinate to inspection.

scope_limits: Lighting category only; no overall score awarded.
Technical, runtime and cold-open stability not certified.
